currentParagraphText: “No, there must be something else behind it. It doesn’t strike me as your work either. Perhaps it’s related to the Void Gods, as they seem to have an interest in Jake? A unique opportunity he’s been given outside of currently known system events or individuals,” Eversmile continued, showing that he was indeed pretty good at deduction.
